notes.title: Patch Drop & New Creepy Shift on the Way!
notes.notes:
Heya creeps!

We’ve just dropped a big patch packed with improvements, fixes, and tweaks based on your feedback:

🛠️ Added plumbing wrench mechanics – you can now fix the kitchen faucet

🎮 Fixed incorrect button icons in the UI

🚀 Improved overall game optimization

👁️ Fixed FOV-related graphical glitches

🐞 General gameplay bug fixes

📊 Improved scoreboard and difficulty balancing

💾 Fixed save system – checkpoint boxes now appear on pallets

🎵 Added music mute option in the main menu (separate slider)

🤲 Polished hand animations and item-carrying ergonomics

But that's not all...

We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]next chapter in the Creepy Shift [/b]series is in the works!
We are cooking surreal blend of simulation, horror, and psychological depth, all wrapped in a dark noir atmosphere.

Game page just went live – don’t miss it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734400/Creepy_Shift_Uncle_Joes_Motel/

Creepy hugs!
— Night Shift Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0 – Improvements, Fixes, and Performance Boost!
notes.notes:
Dear Creeps,

We’re arriving with our very first patch, and here’s what we’ve managed to improve:

[list]
[*] Performance optimizations
[*] Fixed video playback issues on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed issues with Chinese, Korean, and Japanese texts
[*] Translation corrections
[*] Improved controller support
[/list]
The game has been tested on Steam Deck and runs smoothly and fully playable. We’re now waiting for official verification from Steam :)

Thanks for your support! 👾

NST

notes.title: The Door Is Open!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Creeps![/b]

This time, we’ve cooked up a horror simulator spiced with absurd humor and mysterious puzzles for you to unravel. Get ready for an emotional rollercoaster and some unexpected twists and turns!

The game is based on our very own [url=https://youtu.be/7UyGrCxU0gs?si=8lZq-liqKWl7N5-1]creepypasta[/url] and reflects our love for campy horror and the creative freedom that indie game development gives us.

Guys, we’ve poured our hearts, passion, and nearly 10 years of gamedev experience into this game. With this release, we wanted to create something truly original — something we could be proud of.

This launch is a huge moment for us, and it will determine whether we can continue developing this project. If you enjoy the game, we’d be incredibly grateful if you left a positive review on the store page. Your support truly means the world to us.

Creepy Hugs!
Night Shift Team

notes.title: The Wait Is Over: Landing in 3, 2, 1...
notes.notes:
Dear Creeps,

We’re thrilled to announce the release of [b]Creepyshift: House For Sale![/b]
The game will be available this Monday, [b]April 14th at 6:00 PM CEST.[/b]

This time, we’ve cooked up something truly special. Get ready for a hefty dose of fear, mysterious puzzles, and a genre-blending experience you didn’t know you needed. Expect a rollercoaster of emotions — from chills and curiosity to confusion and dark humor.

The game is based on our original creepypasta (which you can listen to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7UyGrCxU0gs]here[/url]) and is a love letter to all things campy horror. We poured our twisted passion into every step of development and we can’t wait to see your reactions.

Creepy hugs,
Night Shift Team
